children: Consumer prices in Chile rose 0.6% in August from the previous month, data from statistics agency INE showed on Tuesday, exceeding a Reuters poll of economists predicted a 0.3% increase.
Annual inflation in the world's largest copper producer hit 4.1%, INE added, surpassing the central bank's 2% to 4% target range.
